# Louvre Dental Centre

> Louvre Dental Centre is a modern family, cosmetic and emergency dental clinic in Paris, Ontario, Canada. We provide comprehensive dental care for the whole family — from children's first checkups to dental implants and smile makeovers — using the latest technology in a calm, comfortable setting. New patients are welcome, we accept the Canadian Dental Care Plan (CDCP), and we offer direct insurance billing.

## Key facts

- **Name:** Louvre Dental Centre (also "Louvre Dental Center")
- **Type:** Family, cosmetic & emergency dental clinic (Dentist)
- **Address:** 1070 Rest Acres Rd, Unit G7, Paris, ON N3L 0K6, Canada
- **Phone:** (519) 442-0132
- **Email:** info@louvredental.ca
- **Hours:** Monday–Friday 10:00 AM–7:00 PM; Saturday 10:00 AM–3:00 PM; Sunday closed
- **Accepting new patients:** Yes, all ages
- **Insurance:** Direct billing to most insurers; Canadian Dental Care Plan (CDCP) accepted
- **Languages:** English, Arabic, Turkish
- **Service area:** Paris, Brantford, St. George, Ayr, Cambridge and Brant County
- **Instagram:** https://www.instagram.com/louvre.dental/
- **Parking:** Free on-site parking; accessible ground-floor entrance

## Services

- Oral hygiene & professional cleanings
- Orthodontics & clear aligners
- Dental implants
- Dental checkups & exams (with digital x-rays)
- Dental crowns
- Dental fillings (tooth-coloured)
- Tooth extractions (including wisdom teeth)
- Emergency dentistry (same-day care held daily)
- Root canal therapy
- Kids / pediatric dentistry
- Cosmetic dentistry & teeth whitening

## Dentists

- **Dr. Kifah Al-Yassin** — Dentist. Graduate of the Alberta School of Dentistry with a Master of Science in Orthodontics; patient-centred, preventive approach.
- **Dr. Kutaiba Alzohaili** — Dentist and Fellow of the Royal College of Dentists of Canada with 20+ years of experience in restorations, cosmetic dentistry, endodontics, and implant & surgical dentistry.
- **Dr. Kübra Yildirim** — Dentist with advanced experience in general dentistry and complex orthodontics; specialises in gentle care for children and families.

The dentists are supported by experienced dental hygienists, assistants and administrative staff.

## Common questions

- **Are you accepting new patients?** Yes — patients of all ages are welcome. Request an appointment online or call (519) 442-0132.
- **Do you offer same-day emergency dental care?** Yes. We reserve time each day for emergencies such as toothaches, broken or knocked-out teeth, lost fillings and swelling.
- **Do you accept CDCP and insurance?** Yes — we accept the Canadian Dental Care Plan and bill most insurers directly.
- **What are your hours?** Monday–Friday 10 AM–7 PM and Saturday 10 AM–3 PM, with evening appointments available.
- **Do you treat children?** Yes — we provide gentle kids dentistry.
